svg.title: The Yukon River and the gravel bar the player walks on: glacier-fed water in three flat `glacier` tones with straight ripple bars and white riffles, then a cobble bar with driftwood, willow and sedge. World y 960..1280; the walk line is the tile's own bottom edge at world 1280 and content/levels/the-north.json theme.path-base continues the same cobble below it, so nothing is drawn under the ground line (art-bible section 6). Opaque full width from its own top edge, so the far-bank tile's last ten rows are covered and the shoreline reads at world 960. THE WATER IS WHY THIS LEVEL ADDED A RAMP, and it is the only ramp added for either of the two levels drawn on 2026-09-13: MEASURED at hsl(176,30%,75%) and hsl(169,23%,59%) on refs/the-north/yukon-river-canyon.jpg, which is twenty-seven degrees of hue from `water` and ten from `copper`, and a glacier-fed river carrying rock flour is pale, desaturated and green-cyan in a way no existing ramp was. The derivation and the duplicate test are in palette.json ramps.glacier. At the low preset this level keeps the sky and this tile, so this is the picture at the tier most phones get. NO FIGURES OF ANY KIND APPEAR ON THIS LEVEL - see assets/style/the-north-level.md section 0.
